  • Shell: 95% viscose derived from bamboo fiber and 5% spandex
  • Imported
  • 【IHDI Certified Hip-Friendly Design】Developed following IHDI guidance, Momcozy sleep sack features a uniquely roomy lower portion that allows for natural “froggy” leg positioning and healthy hip development. It ensures your baby enjoys complete freedom to kick and stretch safely, while the snug upper body provides a secure, womb-like feeling for peaceful sleep.
  • 【3-Stage Adjustable SnapFit】SnapFit system adjusts from newborn to toddler (0-24 Months). 𝐒𝐭𝐚𝐠𝐞 𝟏 (𝐍𝐞𝐰𝐛𝐨𝐫𝐧): Fasten the underarm and bottom snaps for a snug, swaddle-transition fit. 𝐒𝐭𝐚𝐠𝐞 𝟐 (𝐎𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐌𝐨𝐯𝐞): Keep the underarm snaps closed and open the bottom snaps for more room to kick and stretch. 𝐒𝐭𝐚𝐠𝐞 𝟑 (𝐀𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐓𝐨𝐝𝐝𝐥𝐞𝐫): Open both the underarm and bottom snaps for a relaxed fit with more room to move. One wearable blanket grows with your baby.
  • 【Cloud-Soft Sleep Sack for All Seasons】Momcozy swaddle provides cloud-like softness that is gentle on baby’s skin. Breathable and moisture-wicking, the 1.5 TOG rating corresponds to a comfort zone in indoor temperatures of 68-73°F (20-23°C), making it ideal for year-round comfort and helping reduce the risk of overheating.
  • 【Two-Way Zipper for Easy Night Changes】The bottom-up, two-way zipper allows for quick and easy diaper changes without having to fully undress your baby. A soft zipper guard protects delicate skin from pinching, helping maintain warmth and comfort during late-night care, ensures parents and kids get back to sleep faster and with less disruption.
  • 【Soft Scooped Neckline for Sound Sleep】The gently curved scooped neckline prevents chafing and allows comfortable airflow. Flatlock seams eliminate irritation; and the streamlined waist with widened hem prevents riding up. This thoughtful combination creates the optimal environment for deeper, more restful sleep.

Certification Details

OEKO-TEX STANDARD 100

OEKO-TEX® STANDARD 100 certified products require every component of a textiles production including all thread, buttons, and trims to be tested against a list of more than 1,000 regulated and unregulated chemicals which may be harmful to human health. The assessment process is globally standardised, independently conducted, and updated at least once per year based on new scientific information or regulatory requirements.

𝐒𝐭𝐚𝐠𝐞 𝟑 (𝐀𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐓𝐨𝐝𝐝𝐥𝐞𝐫): Open both the underarm and bottom snaps for a relaxed fit with more room to move. One wearable blanket grows with your baby.
  • 【Cloud-Soft Sleep Sack for All Seasons】Momcozy swaddle provides cloud-like softness that is gentle on baby’s skin. Breathable and moisture-wicking, the 1.5 TOG rating corresponds to a comfort zone in indoor temperatures of 68-73°F (20-23°C), making it ideal for year-round comfort and helping reduce the risk of overheating.
  • 【Two-Way Zipper for Easy Night Changes】The bottom-up, two-way zipper allows for quick and easy diaper changes without having to fully undress your baby. A soft zipper guard protects delicate skin from pinching, helping maintain warmth and comfort during late-night care, ensures parents and kids get back to sleep faster and with less disruption.
  • 【Soft Scooped Neckline for Sound Sleep】The gently curved scooped neckline prevents chafing and allows comfortable airflow. Flatlock seams eliminate irritation; and the streamlined waist with widened hem prevents riding up. This thoughtful combination creates the optimal environment for deeper, more restful sleep.

Product Description

Momcozy baby sleep sack is made from 95% bamboo viscose and 5% spandex for soft, breathable comfort. The wearable blanket baby features an IHDI-certified hip-friendly design, letting newborns kick and stretch safely. With a 3-stage SnapFit, it grows with your baby from sleep sack 0-3 months to sleep sack 6-12 months and toddler sleep sacks, adapting from snug to relaxed fits. The 1.5 tog sleep sack provides year-round cozy warmth, while the two-way zipper and scooped neckline make diaper changes and sleep comfortable. Ideal as a sleep sack newborn, newborn sleep sacks, bamboo sleep sack, or part of swaddles for newborns, this Momcozy design supports safe, restful sleep from birth through toddlerhood.
